verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are evidenced only indirectly. Community users describe dashboard popovers showing SDK examples (comm-7), a Python code tab on the site (comm-2), and a competitor marketed as a drop-in replacement "with the same SDK" (comm-9). A published OpenAPI spec (probe-2) supports building clients, but no first-party doc in the pack names or describes the SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party SDK documentation, list of supported languages and package names, SDK reference/versioning details, hands-on SDK usage reports.
